title: Vagabond - Active Effect Fix
description:
Repairs Active Effects in the Vagabond system.

Vagabond's bundled content stores effect changes under system.changes, but Foundry's effect pipeline only reads the native changes array - which is empty on every one of them. The result is that ancestry traits, class features, perks, weapon properties and relic Powers silently do nothing.

This module copies system.changes into changes during data preparation, and only ever fills an empty array, so it stops having any effect the moment the system fixes this itself.
